reachability.notes: Site loads but requires JavaScript - SPA with 'You need to enable JavaScript to run this app' fallback

1.1_llms_txt.details: overtimemarkets.xyz/llms.txt returns the SPA shell (no llms.txt file). docs.overtimemarkets.xyz redirects to docs.overtime.io which has a documentation index at /llms.txt path but it is NOT a valid llms.txt file - it's a docs table of contents.

1.2_markdown_negotiation.details: No evidence of Accept: text/markdown content negotiation. Site serves the same JS-dependent SPA shell regardless of Accept header.

1.3_structured_metadata.details: No meta description, no Open Graph tags, no JSON-LD structured data found in the static HTML. Only a title tag is present: 'Overtime Sportsbook | Unlimited Crypto Sports Betting with Overtime'.

2.1_content_without_js.details: No real text content in HTML. The only static content is 'You need to enable JavaScript to run this app.' Entire UI is client-side rendered.

2.2_semantic_html.details: No semantic HTML tags (nav, main, article, header, footer) found. The page is a bare div-based SPA shell with no semantic structure.

2.3_readable_url_slugs.details: Sitemap reveals readable URL slugs: /markets, /liquidity-pool, /promotions, /referral, /resources, plus descriptive paths like /resources/how-to-bet-on-nfl, /resources/what-is-moneyline-betting. Docs also use clean slugs: /get-started/how-to-bet, /learn-about-overtime/overtime-amm-and-liquidity-mechanics.

2.4_sitemap_xml.details: Valid sitemap.xml at overtimemarkets.xyz/sitemap.xml with 99 URLs covering markets, resources, promotions. Docs site also has sitemap at docs.overtime.io/sitemap.xml. All entries have lastmod, changefreq, and priority.

2.5_proper_404.details: The /this-does-not-exist-xyz123 path returns the same SPA shell with 'You need to enable JavaScript to run this app.' - appears to return 200 with the app shell rather than a proper 404 status code. SPA catch-all routing.

3.1_dev_docs_exist.details: Comprehensive developer docs at docs.overtime.io (redirected from docs.overtimemarkets.xyz). Includes Overtime V2 Integration section with API endpoints (api.overtime.io), smart contract addresses (Optimism network), code examples in JS/ethers.js, Postman collections. Also Speed Markets developer docs with contract ABIs and integration code.

3.2_docs_findable.details: docs.overtimemarkets.xyz redirects cleanly to docs.overtime.io. The docs subdomain is a standard convention. From the main site's sitemap, /resources pages link to guides. Docs are within 1-2 clicks via the subdomain pattern.

3.3_programmatic_surface_documented.details: Well-documented programmatic surface: REST API at api.overtime.io (requires API key), smart contract addresses and ABIs for SportsAMMV2, LiveTradingProcessor, and SpeedMarketsAMM. Code examples for trading, resolving markets. Postman collections available. GitHub links to contracts.

3.4_standard_navigation.details: The main site has zero standard <a href> navigation links in the static HTML. All navigation is JS-rendered. However, the docs site (GitBook-based) does have standard navigation links.

4.1_ai_crawlers_allowed.details: robots.txt at overtimemarkets.xyz has User-agent: * with empty Disallow (all allowed). No AI-specific blocks. Docs site (docs.overtime.io) also allows crawling with minor query parameter restrictions only.

4.2_no_captcha.details: No CAPTCHA elements detected on any tested pages.

4.3_bot_policy_or_agent_docs.details: No explicit bot policy, AI agent documentation, or terms addressing automated access. The API requires an approved API key but there are no published agent-specific guidelines.

score.summary: Overtime scores 7/15 (grade C). The main app is a pure SPA with zero server-side content, no semantic HTML, no meta tags, and no static navigation - making the primary site nearly invisible to agents without a browser. However, the documentation ecosystem is solid: docs.overtime.io provides well-structured developer docs with API endpoints, smart contract addresses, code examples, and Postman collections. Sitemaps are present and robots.txt is permissive. The platform is split: excellent docs accessibility but poor main site accessibility.
